meta.title: Vietnam Trip Itinerary from India for 7, 10, 15 Days | ALL YOU NEED TO KNOW to Plan a Vietnam Trip🇻🇳
meta.description:
Travelling from India to Vietnam and looking for that perfect itinerary to plan the Vietnam trip? This video's for you! Sharing a 10-Day Vietnam itinerary, Vietnam itinerary for a week and 15 days, along with some important tips to remember when travelling to Vietnam. In this, we would be going from South Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City) all the way up north to Hanoi.

Hope this helps you plan a Vietnam trip in 2022!

Gadt Travel website: https://gadttravel.com/

Tours I did:

1. Mekong Delta+ Cu Chi Tunnels: https://gadttravel.com/tour/cu-chi-tunnels-and-mekong-delta-full-day-tour.html
2. Bana Hills: https://gadttravel.com/tour/ba-na-hills-tour-the-road-to-heavenly-scenery.html
3. Ninh Binh: https://gadttravel.com/tour/hoa-lu-ancient-capital-trang-an-complex-and-mua-cave-one-day-from-hanoi.html

Intro : (0:00)
North to South OR South to North? : (1:25)
Ho Chi Minh City: (2:05)
Nha Trang : (3:38)
Dalat : (4:43)
Hoi An & Danang : (5:14)
Hanoi : (6:43)
FINAL Itinerary : (9:11)
Bonus Places : (9:44)
Tips to remember : (11:38)
Outro : (13:27)

#vietnamtravel #vietnam2022
